dialog.publishDescription: Enter the package name and exact version on the private registry. The metadata is read and normalized first; once confirmed the snapshot enters the market and no longer follows the registry.
dialog.previewHint: Only the fields below are stored. The artifact URL is kept for provenance and is never requested by the market.
dialog.previewChanged: The version changed after the preview. Below is the snapshot just read; please confirm again.
dialog.unpublishDescription: {{version}} stops being public, but its snapshot stays in the market and can be restored at any time.
dialog.restoreDescription: {{version}} becomes public again from the frozen snapshot in the market; the registry is not read again.
